system.name: EcoRank
system.one_liner: Budget-constrained text re-ranking: a costlier LLM filters passages pointwise, then a cheaper LLM re-ranks the top ones pairwise.

content.variant_note: two ranking layers on tinted halves, with the 7-passage list redrawn before, between and after them
content.argues: Splitting the budget between a costlier pointwise filter and a cheaper pairwise ranker re-ranks well within a fixed budget.
content.subject: A query and seven passages going through two LLM ranking layers, with coins marking the budget spent per passage.

elements.name: query
elements.role: the question; fed to the first LLM and, by a long bypass arrow, to the second
elements.drawn_as: white rounded box with a heavy black outline, top left

elements.name: Initial Passage List
elements.role: seven candidate passages p1-p7 from the first-stage retriever; p1-p4 go to the LLM, p5-p7 are left unprocessed
elements.drawn_as: column of document-shaped cards, p1-p4 grey with a coin each, p5-p7 orange

elements.name: Unprocessed passages
elements.role: names the orange cards p5-p7 that the budget does not reach
elements.drawn_as: small caption beside the orange cards

elements.name: Budget:
elements.role: the total budget, spent partly in each layer
elements.drawn_as: row of 7 gold coin stacks (3 above 4) at the boundary of the two regions

elements.name: Costlier LLM / Pointwise Ranking
elements.role: judges each of the processed passages yes or no for relevance
elements.drawn_as: tall grey rectangle with a green brain-circuit glyph, name above and operation below in dark red

elements.name: "Yes" / "No"
elements.role: verdict on each passage that decides where it lands in the intermediate list
elements.drawn_as: small quoted words on the output arrows, 2 at the top and 2 at the bottom

elements.name: Intermediate Ranked List
elements.role: list with relevant passages first, unprocessed ones in the middle, irrelevant ones last
elements.drawn_as: dashed frame around 7 cards: p3 and p1 green, p5-p7 orange, p2 and p4 red

elements.name: per-passage coins
elements.role: budget spent on each passage sent to an LLM (4 in layer one, 3 in layer two)
elements.drawn_as: gold coin stack sitting on each arrow into an LLM box

elements.name: Cheaper LLM / Pairwise Ranking
elements.role: compares the top passages of the intermediate list in pairs to order them
elements.drawn_as: tall grey rectangle with a purple brain-circuit glyph, name above and operation below in dark red

elements.name: Final Ranked List
elements.role: the output ranking; the top three are re-ordered, the rest keep their place
elements.drawn_as: dashed frame around 7 cards: p5, p3, p1 teal, p6 and p7 orange, p2 and p4 red

encoding.color_means: blue half = layer one (pointwise, costlier LLM), yellow half = layer two (pairwise, cheaper LLM); card fill = outcome: grey awaiting the first layer, orange unprocessed, green judged Yes, red judged No, teal re-ranked by the second LLM; glyph green = costlier LLM, purple = cheaper LLM

encoding.shape_means: wavy-bottom card = a passage, tall grey box = an LLM ranking operation, rounded box = the query, coin stack = budget
encoding.marker_means: p-numbers name passages; "Yes" and "No" are the pointwise verdicts that place a passage at the top or bottom of the intermediate list
encoding.emphasis: the two tall grey boxes in the middle of each coloured half, with the list columns recoloured around them; the coins make cost the visible subject

lessons.what_to_learn: Redraw one small list after every stage and recolour its items by what the stage decided, so a reader sees the effect of each layer without a text example; put a coin on every arrow that costs budget.
lessons.suits: Multi-stage ranking, filtering or cascade methods that spend a limited resource (budget, compute, calls) on a small ordered set of items.

evidence: A fraction of budget is spent on 4 passages for pointwise prompt with a costlier LLM
an intermediate ranked list is generated with unprocessed passages in the middle

summary: EcoRank re-ranks retrieved passages under a fixed API budget. The figure follows seven example passages through two layers drawn on a blue and a yellow half of the background. In the first, a costlier LLM does pointwise yes/no ranking on four passages, each paid with a coin, giving an intermediate list with relevant passages on top, unprocessed ones in the middle and irrelevant ones at the bottom. In the second, a cheaper LLM does pairwise ranking on the top three and yields the final list. The same list is redrawn three times in dashed frames, with cards recoloured by outcome, and a row of coins on top shows the total budget. Drawn as flat drawio-style boxes with two brain glyphs.
summary_zh: EcoRank 在固定预算下重排段落。图用蓝、黄两半背景表示两层：贵的 LLM 对四个段落做逐点是/否判断，便宜的 LLM 再对前三个做两两比较。同一列七个段落按结果换色重画三次，金币标出每步花费。
notes: The prior pass counted two panels; the two tinted halves have no titles or letters, so they are recorded as lanes of one drawing. The list cards are not pictures (no snippet inside), so they are recorded as elements and icons only.
